question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I will try to _______ because he is a good friend of mine.
solution:
The correct answer is '**get him off the hook**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**get him off the hook**" means to help someone avoid trouble or punishment. (उसे मुसीबत से बाहर निकालना)
 
• Since he is a good friend of mine, the speaker is willing to help him avoid trouble.
 
• The other options: "**avoid him like the plague**," "**show him the door**," and "**stop him in his tracks**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I will try to get him off the hook__ because he is a good friend of mine.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Avoid him like the plague (उससे महामारी की तरह बचना)**: means to deliberately avoid someone.
 
• **Show him the door (उसे दरवाजा दिखाना)**: means to ask someone to leave.
 
• **Stop him in his tracks (उसे रोक देना)**: means to stop someone abruptly.

1df:Tbe1,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
